thread:
olga: Compliance escalated — DSAR for a user requesting complete event history. Vendor retention > our 90d so they want a retention-exception and full chain-of-custody. Also saw Amplitude patch note this morning.
frank: We should pull via vendor API into our controlled bucket instead of relying on vendor portal download. That gives us better audit control.
mina: Agreed. Key questions: which KMS key to use (customer-managed), KMS key policy constraints, and RBAC for retrieval. Legal wants proof of who accessed the package.
sec-ops-bot: Reminder: All exports with possible PII must be SSE-KMS encrypted, object tagged with dsar_id, and retrieval via ephemeral role with MFA and approval. Audit logs must include principal, session context, and artifact checksum.
olga: Proposed flow: 1) service-job calls vendor API with user_id filter -> writes JSONL to s3://priv-dsar/6170012345/events.jsonl using arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/DSAR-6170012345 2) compute sha256 manifest 3) tar + gpg sign 4) store signed artifact and create AuditStore entry linking request id + approvers.
frank: For RBAC create ephemeral role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/dsar_retriever_{ts} with policy limited to GetObject on that prefix only. Require MFA and session tag dsar=6170012345. Use our JIT approval flow (security + legal).
mina: KMS key policy draft: only allow Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey* to two principals: dsar-exporter service role and dsar_retriever role with condition StringEquals kms:EncryptionContext:dsar_id = "6170012345". Also deny decrypt if session lacks tag dsar=6170012345.
sec-ops-bot: Suggested lifecycle: default TTL 24h for exported artifacts unless retention-exception ticket approved. If RE approved, set explicit lifecycle to expire at approved date.
olga: Vendor vuln triage: We need vendor attestation confirming export endpoints weren't affected by their recent patch. Ask for signed statement and timeline. If vendor can't attest, pause and escalate to CISO.
frank: Also scan the exported file with our PII detector (regex + ML model) and include redaction log. If redaction happens we still keep the raw encrypted archive but restrict access to security+legal with documented justification.
mina: For audit proof: include manifest with sha256, GPG signature, CloudTrail entries (PutObject and later GetObject), and an AuditStore record containing requestor identity, justification, approvers, and retrieval timestamps. That should satisfy chain-of-custody.
legal-bot: Legal requires: requester proof (identity verification), confirmation of retention window, and recorded approval for any retention-exception. Also ask vendor for data handling statement.
privacy-bot: Reminder: strip vendor debug headers and tokens from exported payload before packaging. Log redactions. Include redaction script in the evidence bundle. :lock:
olga: Action items: Frank -> implement exporter job + IAM role PR; Mina -> draft KMS key policy and AuditStore schema; Legal-bot -> open RE ticket and request vendor attestation; I'll coordinate verification and run final checks.
frank: One detail: CloudTrail logs for s3:GetObject only show the role ARN — ensure we also require session tags so AuditStore can tie session to dsar. We'll use sts:TagSession in assume-role flow.
mina: I'll add a CloudTrail ingestion rule to copy relevant events to AuditStore and attach to the artifact record. Also will require that object tags include dsar_id and retention_exception_id if present.
legal-bot: Opened RE-1177 https://re.redwood/retention-exceptions/RE-1177 (cc security, compliance). Added note: default hold 7d pending vendor attestation.
sec-ops-bot: Checklist generated: [1] RE ticket, [2] Exporter job, [3] SSE-KMS with CMK + key policy, [4] Manifest + GPG signature, [5] PII scan + redaction log, [6] AuditStore entry + CloudTrail copy, [7] Ephemeral role + JIT approvals, [8] Presigned URL or retrieval window <=1h, [9] TTL lifecycle configured.
olga: Good. If vendor responds clean we proceed. If not, pause and escalate. Keep thread updated with vendor attestation and PR links.
frank: I'll post PR link when ready. Expect prototype tonight.
mina: I'll upload KMS policy snippet to the infra repo and tag you both.
privacy-bot: Final note: do not include plaintext payloads in CI logs or Slack; always reference object path and evidence id. :shield:
